name: Kirishima Touka
source:
Kirishima Touka is a ghoul and a waitress at Anteiku. She wears a rabbit mask while hunting, earning her the alias Rabbit (ラビット). In Tokyo Ghoul, she was a second-year student at Kiyomi High School and later a third-year after the post-Aogiri timeskip.

[From [url=http://tokyoghoul.wikia.com/wiki/Touka_Kirishima]Tokyo Ghoul Wikia[/url]]
